summary: Aquestive Therapeutics filed an 8-K on October 14, 2026, disclosing an October 13, 2026 license agreement with Eton Pharmaceuticals granting exclusive U.S. commercialization rights to LIBERVANT (diazepam) buccal film for seizure clusters, subject to regulatory approvals; LIBERVANT has tentative FDA approval for ages 2-5 and 12+. Aquestive received a $10.0 million upfront fee, potential milestones up to $47.5 million ($10M first sale, $2.5M ages 6-11 approval, $35M sales-based), and mid-teens royalties; a linked 20-year exclusive supply agreement makes Aquestive sole manufacturer.
